entries.prompt: Edit this BIO//PUNK collectible sticker into a refined second art-direction proposal optimized for a 64px thumbnail. Preserve the core identity: a genuinely nonhuman photosynthetic biomechanical king, asymmetrical crouching pose, one immense braced foreclaw, two reverse-jointed legs, a salvaged circular shoulder turbine, serrated carnivorous plant head, chartreuse / bottle-green / black / amber palette, premium expressive comic rendering and genuine transparent background. Make the following coherent art-direction revision: SIMPLIFY INTERNAL VISUAL NOISE while retaining convincing volume and material quality. Remove roughly two-thirds of the tiny root strands, fine leaf veins, moss flecks, etched metal marks and shiny pinprick highlights. Replace those details with a few beautifully designed larger anatomical planes. Make the head about 25 percent larger and clearly separated from the shoulders by a broad near-black shape; give it one very readable concentrated amber eye area and a jaw made of three broad plant blades with only a few large teeth instead of dense saw teeth. Group the torso into a deep matte dark-green body mass with four strong rib plates around ONE amber sap core. Make the immense forearm from two or three thick root tendons and three clean large claws, not dozens of vines. Keep the shoulder turbine visibly mechanical with a simple dark wheel, a clear metallic rim and one warm hub light; remove the tiny foliage around it. Organize the whole painting into three large readable value groups: luminous chartreuse head/shoulder leaf planes, medium green forearm armor, deep cool teal-black torso and legs. Use deliberate dramatic cel-shaded lighting and crisp shadow shapes, subtle gradients only for material form, a few well-placed satin leaf highlights, broad bark facets and restrained brushed metal reflections. Put fine craftsmanship into shape design and controlled edge variation, NOT microtexture. Result should still be a sophisticated premium illustrated mutant, not flat SVG/vector clipart, not a toy or a cute humanoid. Keep the full silhouette, all claws, leaves and ivory die-cut edge inside the square image with at least 8 percent clear transparent margin on every side. No scenery, ground plane, particle cloud, text, numbers, card frame, suit icon, logo, watermark, gore or photographic realism.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE premium collectible card sticker for BALÍK, PANELÁK 3000 edition. A broad pear-shaped enamel body with an integrated tiny lift door in its belly, oversized apron, a cable-coil perm under a translucent peach visor, narrow expressive mechanical eyes and a displeased tilted brow. Its three deliberately different arms form a lively readable composition: one short heavy arm jingles a comically large ring of master keys, one telescopic arm grips a worn broom at a confident diagonal, a small service claw tries to reel in a vacuum hose curled around an oversized purple house slipper. Two large mismatched slipper-covered rolling feet skid into a determined forward step. Beautiful soft key light from upper left, warm bounce light, cool blue rim, deep contact shadows and restrained specular reflections. entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE premium Czech summer comic collectible sticker for BALÍK, CHALUPA! edition. entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE premium collectible theatrical papercut sticker for BALÍK, PAPÍROVÝ CIRKUS edition. Subject: the Cartographer of Dreams, an elegant surreal female marionette physically constructed from many hand-cut paper layers. A narrow ivory folded-paper mask with asymmetric sleepy eye cutouts and a long delicate nose; one curved plum paper hair fan sweeps backward. Long articulated limbs and exposed small paper-fastener joints form a dramatic off-balance dancer's pose: one leg balances on a little folded crescent step, the other extends sideways, one arm raises a gold folded star like a map, the other pulls a ribbon of miniature paper stairs that curls back into her layered cloak. A sculptural multi-layer burgundy and mulberry fan cloak creates depth, with uneven cut edges, stepped ivory lining, and sparse midnight-blue insets. Strong warm theatrical side spotlight, cool soft fill, cast self-shadows; no glowing abstract vector shapes. Palette: plum, dusty burgundy, warm ivory, muted antique gold and small midnight blue accents. Composition: complete expressive marionette and its connected sculptural paper props, centered in a square with generous clean transparent margins, clear silhouette and big value groupings readable at 64px, intricate craftsmanship visible close up.
